_doc: Referencia de todos os inimigos do jogo. Os stats reais estao nos arquivos .tres em data/enemies/. Este JSON e apenas leitura — edite os .tres para modificar os valores no jogo.

enemies.name: Slime
enemies.behavior: Patrol left-right, turn at walls and cliff edges (EdgeRay)

enemies.name: Galinha Voadora
enemies.behavior: Flying: flaps to gain altitude, glides when near max height, chases on sight

enemies.name: Lobo de Gelo
enemies.behavior: Same as Slime — patrol, turn at walls/cliffs, chase on sight

enemies.name: Aguia de Gelo
enemies.behavior: Flying: same as FlyingChicken but with higher stats

enemies.name: Ogro da Floresta
enemies.behavior: Two phases: at 50% HP increases speed and aggression

enemies.name: Yeti de Gelo
enemies.behavior: Two phases: at 50% HP increases speed and aggression

enemies.name: Guardiao da Floresta
enemies.behavior: Multi-phase with special area attack; enrages at <33% HP. Defeating triggers Victory screen.

enemies.name: Dragao de Gelo
enemies.behavior: Multi-phase with special area attack; enrages at <33% HP. Defeating triggers Victory screen.

ai_states._doc: Estados de IA compartilhados por todos os inimigos (BaseEnemy.gd)
ai_states.PATROL: Anda na direcao atual, inverte ao bater em parede ou chegar na beira
ai_states.CHASE: Persegue o jogador mais proximo dentro do raio de deteccao
ai_states.ATTACK: Ataca quando o jogador entra no hitbox de ataque
ai_states.DEAD: Toca animacao de morte, emite sinal, e remove o no
